what: Assurant provides specialised protection products. It insures mobile phones and consumer electronics through carrier partnerships, provides lender-placed home insurance, and sells vehicle service contracts.
customers: Mobile operators, retailers, banks, car dealers and, through them, consumers.
money: mobile device protection, extended warranties and vehicle service contracts
moat: Multi-year exclusive partnerships with mobile carriers and lenders, where it handles the whole programme including claims and device repair, which partners rarely bring in-house.
risks: Losing a large mobile carrier partner would remove meaningful revenue
Catastrophe losses affect the housing business
Net margin of about 7% reflects an insurance business with large premium volumes
Few analysts cover it relative to its size
opportunities: Revenue grew about 8% last year and about 8% a year over three years
Lender-placed housing insurance earns strong margins with little competition
Almost no debt at the holding company with $1.8 billion of cash
watch: Lifestyle partner renewals and the housing combined ratio.
